scope: Five manuscript cases only; frozen cold-model raw probabilities; no inference or training
background: B_common, identical to the stored Route 1 8383-gene background
sampling: A single permutation of gene identities is applied jointly to all five binary target-set columns in each draw; without replacement within each set. Preserves target sizes and every cross-chemical target intersection. Uniform uses all background genes; degree_matched permutes within joint annotation-degree strata.
degree_definition: KEGG degree: number of retained GMT pathways containing a gene. CTD degree: number of distinct disease IDs linked to that inference gene in the full processed KEGG pathway-disease snapshot, before any chemical selection. Match coarse joint strata exactly; not exact degree, study frequency, tissue or assay context.
ora: One-sided hypergeometric upper tail; pathway genes intersected with the same background; BH over all 369 tested pathways separately per chemical and draw. No pathway-state direction inference.
ctd_comparison: Complete FDR<0.05 and overlap>=2 pathways; chemical-specific fixed CTD significant comparable reference. support, recovery, Jaccard; missing reference would be NA, never a negative label.
display_pipeline: FDR<0.05 pathways ordered by FDR, p, decreasing overlap, decreasing fold, then stored GMT order for residual ties; take at most10. Map all CTD pathway-disease associations. Within pathway, rank by log1p(inference-gene count) (equivalent to fold*log1p at fixed pathway); at most10 per pathway, top5 subset for Table S5. Chemical-level disease IDs deduplicated by maximum fold*log1p support across selected pathways; descending display score and disease_id for residual ties; top20.
primary: Mean of the 10 pairwise Jaccards of chemical-level top20 unique disease IDs. If the union is empty, Jaccard=0 (no shared evidence); retain all empty draws and report them. Upper-tail Monte Carlo p=(1+#null>=observed)/(R+1), BH across the two null designs.
secondary_test: CTD pathway Jaccard for each of five chemicals, upper-tail Monte Carlo p, BH over all ten chemical-by-null comparisons. support/recovery/counts/target/pathway/per-pathway-top5 disease overlaps are descriptive, no additional significance claims.
uncertainty: Null quantiles describe random gene relabeling conditional on fixed target sets and snapshots, not model-training uncertainty or biological replication. No parameters or endpoints selected after results.
